scope: QA fixture/control workflow only. No NeAntik Swift/product binary, browser profile, candidate, source offer, signature, public release, or network state changed.

changes.fixture: A phase command waits up to 60 seconds for the expected one-page/one-state response; A1/A2 require proxy A, B1 requires proxy B. A clean unexpected route or state is recorded as a runtime FAIL; no response is a timeout; extra page/state responses are phase-contaminated and are not consumed or written into phase-results.json.

changes.regression: Four focused tests cover late mixed B1/A2 contamination, delayed expected response, wrong-proxy page load, and A2 proxy-A/restored-state requirements.

verification.testRunPlan: scripts/plan-manager-checks.py --path on these two files classified workflow/python-test; no Swift source changed. Focused suite chosen because the change is isolated to this untracked QA fixture, not product runtime or shared manager inputs.
